claims.evidence: Witness photos show a white computerized sewing machine with a visible “brother” brand, but the exact model number (SE630) and embroidery capability are not readable/confirmed.
Witness report shows the brand text “brother” visible on the machine body in photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: Model mismatch or wrong listing (SE630 not confirmed; could be another Brother computerized model).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate (showing “SE630” or exact model number) and the control panel model text.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Brother computerized sewing machine with unknown exact model features.

risks.risk: Not actually working / needs repair (no stitching test, no motor/speed verification).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on plus a stitching test on fabric (showing stitches, speed control, and smooth motor operation).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: may require service).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing all included items laid out (feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) and a check of what is inside the accessory compartment.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/functional wear (scratches, rust, worn moving parts, belt/gear condition).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, underside/belt area (if accessible), and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst visible condition (unknown wear).

risks.risk: Power/voltage or adapter issue (correct power setup not shown; Lagos voltage compatibility not confirmed).
risks.proof: Photo of the power rating label and a video showing it running on the provided power setup.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as requiring verification of correct power/adapter.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate showing the exact model number (e.g., SE630).
Video: power-on and a short stitching test on fabric (show speed control working).
Photos/clip of all included accessories laid out (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual).
Close-up photos of the needle/feed area and any visible wear points (including underside/belt area if possible).
Photo of the power rating label and confirmation of the exact power setup/adapter included.
response.reason: The witness confirms the brand as “brother,” but the seller’s model (SE630) and working condition are not verifiable from the photos. Without a readable model label and a stitching/power test, a reliable worst-case price can’t be set.
